# Affordi

> Affordi is a private calculator that converts a price into the work time needed to afford it.

People enter their take home pay, the times and days they work, and currency, then a price that is paid once, every workday, weekly, monthly, or yearly. Affordi shows the work time it takes and its share of take home pay. An earnings page counts what has been earned today in real time, both around the clock and during working hours, shows how much of this month's pay has been worked for, and breaks pay down per second, minute, hour, day, week, month, and year. Calculations and settings stay in the browser, and no account is required.

## Site

- [Affordi calculator](https://affordi.pages.dev/): Use the calculator in any supported language and install it as a progressive web app.
- [Affordi source and documentation](https://github.com/vladanp/affordi): Review the source code, README, development commands, and release history.
